facts.fact: Shalakany says the CBE's customer-rights instructions of 19 February 2019 apply to banks and providers such as mobile payment companies, with compliance due by February 2020.
facts.system: Instructions for the protection of the rights of bank customers

facts.fact: Shalakany says banks must run a complaints unit whose decisions bind service providers, replying within 15 days, and customers may escalate to the CBE.
facts.system: Instructions for the protection of the rights of bank customers
